## Guide topics

- [Agent request examples](agent-requests.md) — Agent requests, selectors and integrity. Command: `thermite guide agent-requests`. Read before writing an agent request; before patching source or presentation.
- [Data Model](data-model.md) — Objects, I/O, cables and potentials. Command: `thermite guide modeling`. Read before adding devices, wires, cables, io or potentials; use guide schema for exact shapes.
- [Libraries and type shapes](libraries.md) — Types, profiles, locks and optional libraries. Command: `thermite guide libraries`. Read before creating or editing a type; before adding an optional library.
- [View requests and printable packets](views.md) — View roots, requests, packets and paper. Command: `thermite guide views`. Read before writing a view or packet request; before handling R001 or R006.
- [Snapshot, review, watch and PDF](review.md) — Snapshots, semantic review, watch and PDF. Command: `thermite guide review`. Read before reviewing changes or exporting PDF.
- [Function-level circuit symbols](circuit-symbols.md) — Function-level circuit marks. Command: `thermite guide circuit-symbols`. Read before setting circuitSymbols.
- [Source-selected circuit views](circuit-views.md) — Function-based circuit drawings. Command: `thermite guide circuit-views`. Read before drawing function-based circuits.
- [Report and reference selection](report-filtering.md) — Schedule filters and reference indexes. Command: `thermite guide report-filtering`. Read before reading, authoring or exporting a BOM or other report; before filtering reports or packet references.
- [Field-device hookup drawings](signal-loops.md) — Field-device hookups and cordsets. Command: `thermite guide signal-loops`. Read before drawing signal loops, cordsets or enclosures.
- [Connection completeness](completeness.md) — Required, unused and deferred connections. Command: `thermite guide completeness`. Read before reviewing connection requirements or model coverage.
